rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it inaccurately calls it a well-expanded/full blastocyst consistent with Gardner 2 and overstates confidence in AA features; TE and ICM are not sharply defined on this image.
Integrates age, ovarian response, BMI, endometrium, prior cycle history, and semen parameters well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter despite good morphology.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, linking embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issue is somewhat optimistic interpretation of morphology and implantation probability for this specific context.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET, standard luteal support, no bed rest, and selective discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviation is the optimistic success estimate and loose handling of Gardner stage terminology.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and sensible future planning, including SET, luteal support, and when to consider further evaluation or PGT-A, though recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
